description: Fetch one item by id with what search results leave out: use cases, try_it, pictures, the reader's note, what people wrote in chat when sharing it, tools found inside it (e.g. the repos a post linked) and up to 5 related cards. Use driftnet_search_items first when you don't have an id yet. id is the number shown in search or save results; ids of trashed items work too and come back with trashed: true, so you can look before restoring. Fails if no item has that id, or if it was flagged for prompt injection (such items are hidden everywhere).

id.description: Item id from driftnet_search_items or driftnet_save_link, a positive integer such as 42

name: driftnet_get_item
title: Get one item
